Congratulations on 11 years with the company! Seniority gives you extra holiday days: after 10 years of service you receive 3 additional days, so you have 26 days of annual leave in total. You can request them in the HR portal as usual.

Yes, you can. Unused holiday days can be carried over into the next year, up to a maximum of 8 days, and you should try to take them in the first quarter. If you cannot take them, HR can arrange for them to be paid out with your salary, so nothing is lost.

In eligible roles you can work from home up to 3 days per week. Tuesday is the office day for all teams, so plan your remote days around it. Your remote-work agreement is reviewed once a year with your line manager.

Several colleagues already do this, for example Ana García from Sales works from Lisbon every year. Just let HR know in advance so they can update your agreement.
No, home internet is not reimbursed. The company provides a laptop, a monitor and a chair for your home office, and there is a one-off allowance of 300 EUR for other equipment you may need.

When travelling abroad on business you can claim up to 55 EUR per day for meals against receipts (the limit in Spain is 35 EUR per day). Alcoholic drinks are not reimbursed, so keep them off the receipt.

Yes, taxis to and from the airport are always reimbursed as part of business travel, as long as you keep the receipt and submit it in the expenses app. For longer distances a rental car may be more convenient; just ask your manager first.

You have 30 days after the trip to submit your receipts in the expenses app. If you miss the deadline you will need written approval from your department director before the claim can be processed, so try to do it as soon as you are back.

Each parent gets 16 weeks of paid parental leave at 100% of salary under Spanish law, and TelcoNova adds 2 company weeks on top, so 18 weeks in total. The first 6 weeks must be taken right after the birth. After that you can also request up to 4 additional weeks unpaid if you want to extend your time at home.

Yes. You can request a reduction of your working hours between 12.5% and 50% until your child turns 12, with a proportional reduction in salary. Give HR 15 days' notice; the company cannot refuse the request, although it may reschedule it once for business reasons.

The salary band for a senior data analyst at TelcoNova is approximately 45,000 to 58,000 EUR per year, depending on experience and location, plus the annual bonus. Your manager can tell you where you sit within the band and what the next step would be.
